exposure: Degree of antenatal suspicion of placenta accreta (lower risk vs. higher risk based on imaging)
outcome: Composite maternal morbidity (cesarean hysterectomy, transfusion, cystotomy, ICU admission)
cohort: 78 women with suspected placenta accreta on imaging (36 with 'lower risk' features and 42 with 'higher risk' features)
finding: Stratification of women with suspected accreta based on imaging corresponded to rates of maternal morbidity and operative complications and appears to have been used clinically in selecting timing of delivery and interventions.
gest_age: Median gestational age at planned delivery: 36.6 weeks ('lower risk' group) vs. 34.9 weeks ('higher risk' group); median gestational age at actual delivery: 36.0 weeks ('lower risk' group) vs. 34.7 weeks ('higher risk' group)
